labels.R_DL: 残差边界 · 冻结 DL

limits: Official source roofs are shown unchanged in the existing separate overlay. Unverified registration prevents a GT accuracy ranking.
R_geometry shares the old DL main-roof/point-semantic prior; it is not a strictly DL-free baseline.
R_DL reuses frozen neural checkpoints with explicit rule-based image observability gating; no new network training is claimed.
Candidate boundaries/geometry use original production observations only; optical nonvisibility is not an absence label.
Holdout consistency is a conditional observation diagnostic, not GT accuracy or tree classification accuracy.

Model-chosen unchanged B priors may inherit invalid source rings. Exact source-face and cached/fresh roof/full hashes are required; their existing cached preview is preserved with warnings and no repair. New applied geometry has a separate strict validity and wall-coverage gate.
Generated walls/bottoms are derived output and do not certify watertight solids.
